items.headline: 幾內亞垃圾場崩塌30死
items.context: 幾內亞首都一處大型垃圾掩埋場，因連日豪雨引發坍方，掩埋了附近多間民宅，政府表示至少30人罹難。
items.thread_text:

幾內亞首都一處大型垃圾掩埋場遭連日豪雨引發坍方，土石掩埋了附近多間民宅，當局表示，這起事故已造成至少30人罹難。

—— 本則來自 Al Jazeera、BBC，2026 年 8 月發佈。

本則整理自 Al Jazeera 與 BBC 於 2026 年 8 月發佈的報導。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月發佈的報導（目前為單一來源）。

阿德曼動畫創辦人專訪

英國定格動畫工作室阿德曼動畫（Aardman Animations）的兩位共同創辦人彼得・洛德（Peter Lord）與大衛・斯普羅克斯頓（David Sproxton），接受了一次難得的專訪。兩人從青少年時期就開始自己動手做動畫，1972年把生涯第一部短片賣給BBC兒童節目《Vision On》，1977年又替節目《Take Hart》創作出後來大受歡迎的黏土角色莫夫（Morph）。受訪中兩人還笑談，曾在奧斯卡頒獎典禮的洗手間，巧遇好萊塢巨星傑克・尼柯遜（Jack Nicholson）。

本則來自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月發佈的報導（目前為單一來源）。

voice.text: 阿德曼動畫的兩位創辦人，難得一起接受專訪。彼得・洛德和大衛・斯普羅克斯頓，從青少年時期就開始自己做動畫。1972年，他們把生涯第一部短片賣給BBC的兒童節目。1977年，兩人又創作出後來大受歡迎的黏土角色莫夫。受訪時他們還笑說，曾在奧斯卡典禮的洗手間，巧遇巨星傑克・尼柯遜。

sources.summary: The ​s​tudio’s co-founders on ​accidentally creating Morph, not wanting a yacht in the Maldives and being each other’s best ally Peter Lord and David Sproxton are the founders of Aardman Animations. The pair began animating as teenagers, selling their first short – starring a superhero called Aardman – to the BBC’s Vision On in 1972. In 1977, they created Morph for the children’s programme Take Hart. The studio’s breakthrough into adult audiences came via Channel 4’s Conversation Pieces series, and its animators, including a young Nick Park, went on to make Wallace & Gromit, whose films have won multiple Academy Awards. Aardman became employee-owned in 2018, with Lord and Sproxton transferring majority ownership to staff to safeguard the company’s independence. They were knighted earlier this year. sources.summary: The drive-in demands little of its audience. You can lie down, bring your dog and talk without fear of being hushed. Mridula Amin spent a night at one of the last of a dying breed Between a funeral parlour and a sink factory, a queue of cars slowly disappears down a driveway. Most arrive with plenty of time to spare – to turn their backseats into beds, tune their radios to the film audio and let children play on the bitumen or finish their takeaway dinner. By the time darkness falls, hundreds of cars are pointed towards a screen that has outlived almost every other drive-in in Melbourne. “There’s something about watching a film under the stars, in the night air,” says Michael O’Neill, a car detailer who lives in Echuca, a five-hour return trip from the Coburg Drive-In. 受低壓帶與西南風雙重影響，台灣南部連日降雨不停。氣象署自22日晚間5時起，啟動較大規模、較劇烈的豪雨應變作業，預期這波雨勢要一路下到週二才會趨緩。由於研判還可能出現更劇烈的強降雨，台南、高雄、屏東三縣市因此宣布23日停班停課。

本則來自 公視新聞 於 2026 年 8 月發佈的報導（目前為單一來源）。
